title: Cook's Farewell Conference Call: Implies Chinese Memory Chip Involvement in Apple Intelligence, China Launch Approved
excerpt: Apple released its fiscal year 2026 third-quarter financial results, with CEO Tim Cook attending the analyst call for the last time as the company's leader. He
content_html:
Apple released its fiscal year 2026 third-quarter financial results, with CEO Tim Cook attending the analyst call for the last time as the company's leader. He stated that the handover to incoming CEO John Tornetta is "proceeding smoothly," and Tornetta will officially take over on September 1. At this farewell meeting, several signals from Cook are worth noting.

Supply Chain in Crisis, Cook Rarely Names Memory and TSMC

The report shows that Apple's total revenue for the third fiscal quarter was $109.417 billion, an increase of 16% year-over-year, with a net profit of $29.789 billion, up 27% year-over-year. However, both the service business and China region revenue fell short of expectations, causing the stock to drop 8% after hours. The guidance for revenue growth in the fourth fiscal quarter is between 9% and 11%, also below analysts' expectations of over 12%, with the main cause being supply chain shortages.

Cook admitted that the flexibility of the supply chain has fallen below normal levels, and the impact on iPhones, Macs, and iPads will significantly increase compared to the previous quarter. The main bottleneck lies in the production of advanced chips, implying that TSMC has not provided enough wafers. More notably, Cook's comments on the memory supply issue were particularly attention-grabbing—he said it would be better if there were more than three memory suppliers, and Apple is evaluating all options, which is widely interpreted as opening the door to Chinese memory manufacturers. Cook described the current memory price situation as a "once-in-a-century flood," forcing Apple to raise prices.

AI Launch Approved in China, 150 Million Paid Users as a Foundation

In terms of AI development, Cook revealed that developers and beta testers have given "very enthusiastic" feedback on the Siri AI features. Apple has been approved to launch its first Apple Intelligence functions in China, and the company is currently working on implementation. However, fully introducing Siri AI to the Chinese market still requires more work. Cook also announced that Apple's paid subscription users have surpassed 1.5 billion, providing a large base of paying users for AI feature distribution.

At his final opportunity to address analysts as CEO, Cook also highlighted that the Mac business set a historical record in emerging markets, especially in China. For this outgoing leader, the underlying challenges in the supply chain and the breakthrough of AI in the Chinese market may be the most significant and challenging "assignment" he leaves for his successor.

content_html_zh:
苹果发布了2026财年第三季度财务业绩，首席执行官蒂姆·库克最后一次作为公司负责人出席分析师电话会议。 他表示，向即将上任的首席执行官 John Tornetta 的交接工作“进展顺利”，Tornetta 将于 9 月 1 日正式接任。 在这次告别会上，库克发出的几个信号值得注意。

供应链陷入危机，库克罕见点名内存和台积电

报告显示，苹果第三财季总营收为1094.17亿美元，同比增长16%，净利润297.89亿美元，同比增长27%。 然而，服务业务和中国区营收均未达预期，导致该股盘后大跌8%。 第四财季收入增长指引在9%至11%之间，也低于分析师12%以上的预期，主要原因是供应链短缺。

库克承认，供应链的灵活性已低于正常水平，对 iPhone、Mac 和 iPad 的影响将较上季度显着加大。 主要瓶颈在于先进芯片的生产，这意味着台积电没有提供足够的晶圆。 更值得注意的是，库克对内存供应问题的言论尤其引人关注——他表示内存供应商最好超过三个，而苹果正在评估所有选项，这被广泛解读为向中国内存制造商敞开大门。 库克将当前的内存价格形势描述为“百年一遇的洪水”，迫使苹果提高价格。

AI在中国获批，1.5亿付费用户为基础

在人工智能开发方面，库克透露，开发者和测试人员对 Siri 人工智能功能给出了“非常热情”的反馈。 苹果公司已获准在中国推出首个Apple Intelligence功能，目前正在积极实施。 不过，将Siri AI全面引入中国市场仍需要更多工作。 库克还宣布，苹果付费订阅用户已突破15亿，为AI功能分发提供了庞大的付费用户基础。

在作为首席执行官向分析师发表讲话的最后一次机会中，库克还强调，Mac 业务在新兴市场（尤其是中国）创下了历史记录。 对于这位即将离任的领导人来说，供应链的潜在挑战以及人工智能在中国市场的突破可能是他留给继任者的最重大、最具挑战性的“任务”。
